text: This report recommends that the name "Douglas Browne Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Queen Street East, extending between Wineva Avenue and Hammersmith Avenue. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Douglas Browne Lane" for an existing public lane located north of Queen Street East, extending between Wineva Avenue and Hammersmith Avenue.
